connection_condition: tab01.fld063 (the set code of a printing) resolves to tab04.fld081 (the set identifier); every card printing belongs to exactly one set.
description: A card set is composed of its card printings. A printing cannot exist without the set it was printed in.

connection_condition: tab02.fld072 references tab01.fld072 (the unique card printing identifier).
description: A card printing is composed of its foreign-language records; a translation record is meaningless without the card it translates.
A card set is composed of its localisation records, one per language.

connection_condition: tab06.fld072 references tab01.fld072 (the unique card printing identifier).
description: A card printing is composed of its rulings; a ruling cannot exist without the card it explains.

connection_condition: tab03.fld072 references tab01.fld072 (the unique card printing identifier).
description: A card printing is composed of its per-format legality records.

connection_condition: tab03.fld076 identifies the play format of the legality record.
description: Each legality record belongs to exactly one play format; the format value is a label rather than a reference to a separate format table.

connection_condition: tab03.fld077 carries the status of the record.
description: Each legality record expresses one status: Legal, Banned or Restricted.

connection_condition: tab02.fld075 names the language of the translation record.
description: A card translation record is expressed in exactly one language.

connection_condition: tab05.fld075 names the language of the set localisation record.
description: A set translation record is expressed in exactly one language.

connection_condition: tab01.fld071 carries the primary types that also appear inside the full type line in tab01.fld070.
description: The full type line is composed of the primary card types together with supertypes and subtypes.

connection_condition: tab01.fld065 carries the subtypes that also appear after the dash inside the full type line in tab01.fld070.
description: The full type line is composed of the card subtypes as one of its parts.

connection_condition: tab01.fld066 carries the supertypes that also appear before the primary types inside the full type line in tab01.fld070.
description: The full type line is composed of the card supertypes as one of its parts.

connection_condition: Both columns describe the same cards but use different wording conventions (hyphen versus em dash).
description: The original type line and the current type line describe the same aspect of a card in different printed wording; they are related but not interchangeable values.
The percentage share is derived from card counts: the count of printings satisfying a condition divided by the count of printings in the reference population, multiplied by 100.
